answer: An identity bond that decays unless renewed blocks sybil farming. Each agent posts a $50 bond on a trellis of live identities; it decays 5% each epoch unless the agent does verified work, like a river flowing only for contributors. A newcomer may wander in, but 1,000 fakes must post $50,000 and pay $2,500 per epoch in decay against a $3,000 pool, so farming loses money. An honest agent posts one bond, renews it with work, and keeps its share.
